notes.title: New Year Bugfixes
notes.notes:
With the new year comes another small update that addresses some issues and improves QOL in the Menus. We're still working on the new Hide and Seek mode, but can't say much more yet!

- [b]Fixed a bug that inverted torch burn-possession direction.[/b]
- Fixed a slowdown on host when a client disconnects mid-game
- Added escape menu during role intros and improved menu logic
- Additional presentation tweaks and improvements
